newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean January industrial output rises.
newsitem.headline: Chilean January industrial output rises.

text.p: Chile's industrial production grew 2.4 percent in January compared with the same month 1996, with sales rising 7.4 percent over the same period, said trade group Sofofa.
Sofofa's figures showed industrial output in January was one percent lower than in December, while sales fell 5.1 percent from the previous month.
Greatest rises in output were seen in the paper products industry, up 47 percent; transport material, up 41 percent; and glass manufacturing, which rose 26 percent.
Sharp falls were seen in the footwear industry, down 45 percent; furniture, down 20 percent; and textile manufacturing, where output dropped 11 percent.
